The project was developed based on recommendations and calculations obtained from geological, seismic and other necessary studies. The construction uses tunnel formwork, where vertical reinforced concrete columns and horizontal slabs create a strong monolithic structure with high seismic resistance. The exterior and interior walls of the house are made of brick.
